verdict.rationale: Anrok's AI Atlas lets users ask natural-language questions about their sales tax and get reasoned answers grounded in their own transactions, registrations, filings and certificates. Headless Tax claims tax work can be 'handed to your agents'. The evidence shows natural-language querying, not natural-language commands that perform actions such as filing, registering or voiding. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can execute operations (not just answer questions), details on what agents can actually do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
